title: Emma & Maya
description: Maya has been missing for 3 days. Emma needs help finding her...

questions.question: To reassure me, can you first check if Maya is still alive? Tell me how you can confirm this info please.
questions.hint: Check the health apps please.

questions.question: Thanks, that reassures me a bit... She disappeared 3 days ago. Was she supposed to see someone that day? If yes, how many people?
questions.hint: Count the appointments scheduled in her calendar that day.

questions.question: Who was the first person she was supposed to see?
questions.hint: Check the first event in the calendar.

questions.question: This Lucas, how old is he?
questions.hint: Search on Instagram for Lucas's profile, then look at the comments on his posts. (Pay attention to the date)

questions.question: What's his job?
questions.hint: Check his Instagram bio.

questions.question: Ok, and why did Maya and Lucas meet?
questions.hint: Check the Fitness app, on the date they met.

questions.question: Do you see Lucas as a suspect? How could you clear him?
questions.hint: Look for an email sent by Maya to Lucas.

questions.question: Ok, so who's the second person Maya was supposed to see?
questions.hint: Check the second appointment of the day.

questions.question: Do Maya and Alex usually meet up? If yes, where?
questions.hint: Look at their conversation, and make the connection each time they meet with Airbnb.

questions.question: Who exactly is Alex to Maya?
questions.hint: If they meet in love rooms but they're not a couple, you figure it out.

questions.question: Did Alex suggest something unusual to Maya in the days before her disappearance?
questions.hint: Look for an unusual proposal in their messages.

questions.question: Try to find out what Alex told Maya during that call please?
questions.hint: Check the notes.

questions.question: I'm sure Alex did something to Maya, I never liked him. Try to find if Alex said or did something suspicious about Maya recently?
questions.hint: Check on Instagram, look everywhere carefully. Further than his profile.

questions.question: What's the last thing Maya said or did on her phone? That could help us track her down...
questions.hint: Check her last messages sent.

questions.question: Hmm interesting... Try to find out where she was going please?
questions.hint: Look for her train ticket, to find the exact stop, go to Clock.

questions.question: That's weird... Where did Alex and Maya meet for their dates?
questions.hint: Go back to Calendar.

questions.question: So Alex and Maya met in Malakoff but she went to Angoulême... Try to find out why she went there?
questions.hint: Search in a dating app.

questions.question: Oh yeah Hinge... What's his first and last name please?
questions.hint: To find the guy's first and last name, go to Safari and do a photo search.

questions.question: What??? But this is a psycho profile... And I was doubting Alex... Can you find info on him? What exactly did he do?
questions.hint: Analyze the Safari page to find the info.

questions.question: How old is he?
questions.hint: Analyze the Safari page to find the info.

questions.question: Try to find his address and I'll call the police so they can arrest him before he hurts Maya... Hurry please!
questions.hint: You need to do another text search in Safari, to get more information about him.

textSuccess: I'm calling the police right now with the address and the number. Thanks for everything... You may have just saved Maya's life.

onboardingContent.text: Hey... A friend told me about you. She said you're really good at stalking, investigating, and seeing what others can't. I need your help, it's really urgent.
Let me explain, Maya is my best friend since high school. We talk literally every single day, no exceptions. She's always on her phone and replies almost instantly.
But for three days now... nothing. No messages, no calls, no sign of life. Not even a like or a story. The police tell me to wait, that it happens... but three days is really not like her!!
We're so close that I easily have access to her phone, especially in emergencies like this. I'm giving you access. Help me understand what's going on so I can find her please...

![Oscar Safran](https://imgcaller.3t.net.vn/MobileDetective/v1/emmaMaya/hinge/max/image-1.webp)

Oscar Safran, 30, from Angoulême, was arrested last Tuesday for identity theft. The man was using the name "Max" on social media and dating apps.

This is not the first time the individual has had trouble with the law. Already arrested in 2019 and 2021 for similar offenses, he had received suspended sentences.

According to our sources, Oscar Safran created fake profiles to approach young women by pretending to be someone else.

The man was released after being held in custody.

---

![Raphaël Dupont](https://imgcaller.3t.net.vn/MobileDetective/v1/emmaMaya/photos/photo_de_raphael.webp)

The Villeurbanne basketball club welcomes a new face. Raphaël Dupont, 28, takes over the club's junior team.

A former semi-professional player, he decided to turn to coaching after a knee injury ended his playing career.

"I want to pass on my passion to young people," he says. "Basketball taught me everything: discipline, teamwork, pushing beyond limits."

Raphaël Dupont will coach the U17 team starting this September.
